resources.string: Module active — probe is attached to X.
Module NOT active. Enable it in LSPosed, tick X in the scope list, then force-stop X so it restarts with the module loaded.

The file appears as soon as X restarts with the module loaded — it does not wait for a video. If it is missing, force-stop X and reopen it.\n\nTo send it: open the folder below, long-press the file, share.
This app cannot read the file itself: Android only lets the app that created it see it, and X is the writer. That is expected.
No app available to open Downloads. Use your file manager and go to Download/XVideoCatcher.
